purpose: Admit the owner-requested Final Public Experience v1 presentation-only continuation of PR #5431 before IR-20 completion. Registration intent ships through separately gated PR #5433 before homepage CTAs are accepted. No API, DB, permissions, external activation or release-policy changes.

requiredBoundaries: WCAG serious and critical violations equal zero
participant perspective does not grant access or change permissions
public form sends no personal data
root no-JavaScript fallback exposes no personal-data fields
form-open analytics is separate from validated request submission
public capability copy contains no development-stage or maturity-status language
external-system descriptions communicate function without claiming verified connectivity
public authority route emits title description canonical hreflang and crawlability metadata
root metadata injection preserves service worker recovery and analytics bootstrap scripts byte-for-byte
Lighthouse evidence is collected from a local production build and is not represented as live VPS evidence
Lighthouse CLI version is pinned and reports are uploaded only as private GitHub Actions artifacts

Preserve all nine roles, seven stage cases, locale/viewport/browser matrix, keyboard, accessibility, no-network and inactive-action assertions.

The final-polish and international-homepage tests may migrate only retired homepage hero/progress-rail/composition selectors and connected-organisation employee copy. Preserve canonical header, all locales, semantic HTML, touch targets, reduced motion, routing, SEO, privacy, access-control and unrelated assertions. Do not add skips or compatibility-only comments to satisfy tests.

The public Gekta brand test may migrate only the moved human-decision boundary and renamed public page title. The release checker and live script must assert the final RU/EN/ZH hero and CTA contract using executable checks, not compatibility comments. Preserve every exact-SHA, production authority, transport, replay, security and threshold assertion.

The operating organization-connect copy is the runtime alias target. Change only pre-registration assistance wording in RU/EN/ZH; preserve consent, payload, submission, verification and server authority.

The seven added unit suites and production-mobile suite may migrate obsolete homepage composition/copy/selectors to the final contract. Preserve route, viewport, locale, keyboard, touch-target, overflow and accessibility coverage. Preserve unrelated private-cabinet and authority assertions; no skips, blanket snapshots or weakened safety checks.

The ai-in-action page and component may only align public title and connected-organisation employee wording in RU/EN/ZH with the homepage. Existing role keys, public/private boundaries, events, Gekta runtime, evidence and financial authority remain unchanged. Update only matching public role/title assertions in admitted test files.
No Netlify or Vercel production dependency
No real transaction authority in the public scenario
No claim that bank, FGIS, EDI or another external system is connected without verified runtime evidence
RU, EN and ZH content remain complete

After this governance PR reaches main, inherit accepted main and remove implementation-local scope edits. Exact-head independent review, owner audit, all substantive CI and REG.RU production acceptance remain mandatory.
The changed live-acceptance script may update only public presentation selectors and assertions; no release permission, threshold, transport or protected operation is changed.

The three existing homepage browser suites must migrate their retired H1/dashboard/section assertions to Final Public Experience v1. Preserve all browser/viewport/locale coverage, keyboard/focus, minimum target and font, no-overflow and accessibility thresholds; retain every unrelated route assertion. Do not skip tests or remove suites from the acceptance config.
